Shooting and EpicRaw Decoding

Process frame data in the following order:

  1. Trigger the shoot and get frameId.

  2. Download EpicRaw by frameId.

  3. Load bytes to EpicRawDocument.

  4. Decoding the image, depth, cloud, inner cucumber or elemental metadata from the same document on a needs basis.

C#

ApiResponse<string> trigger = await EpicEye.TriggerCaptureAsync(ip);
string frameId = trigger.Data!;

var (rawBytes, transmitMs, speedMbps) =
    await EpicEye.GetFrameInEpicRawWithTimeStatsAsync(ip, frameId);
if (rawBytes is null
    || !EpicEye.TryLoadEpicRawDocumentFromBytes(rawBytes, out var document)
    || document is null)
{
    throw new InvalidDataException("EpicRaw Invalid");
}

var (image, imageWidth, imageHeight) =
    EpicEye.DecodeImageFromEpicRaw(document);
var (depth, depthWidth, depthHeight) =
    EpicEye.DecodeDepthFromEpicRaw(document);

var (distortion, cameraMatrix, lutWidth, lutHeight) =
    EpicEye.GetDepthIntrinsicsFromEpicRaw(document);
byte[]? lut = await EpicEye.GetUndistortLutAsync(
    ip,
    timeout: 15000,
    depthWidth: lutWidth,
    depthHeight: lutHeight,
    cameraMatrix: cameraMatrix,
    distortion: distortion);
var (pointCloud, pointCloudWidth, pointCloudHeight) =
    EpicEye.DecodePointCloudFromEpicRaw(document, lut);

transmitMs Statistics only HTTP The response is time-consuming.speedMbps is the average transmission rate for this responder.

Python

frame_id = epiceye.trigger_frame(ip, pointcloud=True)
raw = epiceye.get_frame_in_epicraw(ip, frame_id)
document = epiceye.try_load_epic_raw_document_from_bytes(raw)

image = epiceye.decode_image_from_epicraw(document)
depth, depth_width, depth_height = epiceye.decode_depth_from_epicraw(document)

distortion, camera_matrix, lut_width, lut_height = (
    epiceye.get_depth_intrinsics_from_epicraw(document)
)
lut = epiceye.get_undistort_lut(
    ip, lut_width, lut_height, camera_matrix, distortion
)
cloud, cloud_width, cloud_height = (
    epiceye.decode_point_cloud_from_epicraw(document, lut)
)

C++

std::string frameId;
TFTech::EpicEye::triggerFrame(ip, frameId, true);

std::vector<uint8_t> rawBytes;
TFTech::EpicEye::getFrameInEpicRaw(ip, frameId, rawBytes);

TFTech::EpicRawDocument document;
TFTech::EpicEye::tryLoadEpicRawDocumentFromBytes(rawBytes, document);

std::vector<uint8_t> image;
int imageWidth = 0, imageHeight = 0, channelBytes = 0;
TFTech::EpicEye::decodeImageFromEpicRaw(
    document, image, imageWidth, imageHeight, channelBytes);

std::vector<float> depth;
int depthWidth = 0, depthHeight = 0;
TFTech::EpicEye::decodeDepthFromEpicRaw(
    document, depth, depthWidth, depthHeight);

std::vector<double> distortion, cameraMatrix;
int lutWidth = 0, lutHeight = 0;
TFTech::EpicEye::getDepthIntrinsicsFromEpicRaw(
    document, distortion, cameraMatrix, lutWidth, lutHeight);
std::vector<float> lut;
TFTech::EpicEye::getUndistortLut(
    ip, lutWidth, lutHeight, cameraMatrix, distortion, lut);

std::vector<float> cloud;
int cloudWidth = 0, cloudHeight = 0;
TFTech::EpicEye::decodePointCloudFromEpicRaw(
    document, lut, cloud, cloudWidth, cloudHeight);

Depth and point cloud units are millimetres. A cloud memory layout is H × W × 3, the channel order is (X, Y, Z).

Passive Double-Purpose

Passive Double-eyes EpicRaw3 Medium DepthSrcImg1, DepthSrcImg2 For the necessary elements,TextureBGR is the optional element. The resolution returns the two-way deep source map in a fixed order, with the available textures added.

C#

IReadOnlyList<EpicRawImage>? images =
    EpicEye.DecodePassiveBinocularImagesFromEpicRaw(document);

Python

left, right, texture = (
    epiceye.decode_passive_binocular_images_from_epicraw(document)
)

Python Back NumPy Triple group; when no texture texture is None.

C++

std::vector<EpicRawImage> images;
bool ok = EpicEye::decodePassiveBinocularImagesFromEpicRaw(
    document, images);

C# / C++ The description item contains data type, width, high,OpenCV MatType and zero copies read only data views. The two-way map is missing or the length of the element is associated with MatType Parsing failed when matching; return when texture does not exist 2 item, the whole resolution failed when texture exists but is invalid.
